fact: Portal de T.I. reports that the SEPE (Sistema Electrónico de Serviços Públicos) portal is online and functional, with registration and authentication, a service catalogue and electronic services in employment, education, health, transport and business available to citizens and companies.

The article says Simplifica 1.0 (2021) and 2.0 (2023), reached through www.sepe.gov.ao, carry services for certificates, registrations, authorizations and licensing, with digital use compulsory or priority.

The article says requests for homologation of higher-education studies currently go through the Portal dos Serviços Públicos Electronicos (SEPE), and that this stays for three years while a new QR-code procedure approved by the Council of Ministers on 27 October 2026 begins.
